options.content:
# 流式接口响应与完整生命周期
聊天 `POST /api/v1/conversations/:id/messages`、`.../regenerate` 是 SSE：2秒目标只用于客户端首个可见正文/已启用思考 token 的 commit。Creator `POST /api/creator/polish` 是 **NDJSON**：2秒目标用于 headers/首段可见文本。客户端 full 与服务端 onResponse 是完整流诊断，只用于容量/长尾，**不设 2 秒 SLO**，也不能与首字 P95 相减。所有成功分位数必须与 terminal、N、离页/后台/取消共同查看；无数据不补 0。

panels.title: 协议与 2 秒目标边界

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_first_token" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_roleplay_first_token" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_stage="first_token" | context_outcome="observed" | context_action=~"$chat_action" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (context_action, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: SSE 首个可见 token P95（目标 ≤2000ms）

panels.description: 成功首字样本内的 2 秒占比；超时/离页等终态另列，不填 0。

targets.expr: sum by (context_action, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_first_token" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_roleplay_first_token" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_stage="first_token" | context_outcome="observed" | context_action=~"$chat_action" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | duration_ms <= 2000 [$__range])) / sum by (context_action, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_first_token" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_roleplay_first_token" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_stage="first_token" | context_outcome="observed" | context_action=~"$chat_action" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" [$__range]))

panels.title: SSE 首字 2秒内占比

panels.description: 首字结果 N 与完整流结果分开；按 stage/action/outcome 查看超时、离页、后台和取消。

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_stage, event_data_action, event_data_tg_platform, event_data_outcome) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_terminal" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_roleplay_terminal" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | event_data_stage=~"first_token|full_reply" | event_data_action=~"$chat_action" | event_data_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" [$__auto]))

panels.title: SSE 首字/完整流结果与样本分母

panels.description: 客户端从动作开始到完整 reply 终态，仅诊断长尾；没有 2 秒阈值。

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_full_reply" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_roleplay_full_reply" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_stage="full_reply" | context_outcome="complete" | context_action=~"$chat_action" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_action, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: 诊断：SSE 客户端完整回复 P95（无2秒 SLO）

panels.description: Creator polish 是 NDJSON。headers 与 first_text 均从调用起点计时；红线 2000ms。

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |~ "st_creator_polish_(headers|first_text)" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type=~"st_creator_polish_(headers|first_text)" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_source_measurement_version="creator_polish_v1" | context_target=~"$polish_target" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (type, context_target, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: NDJSON headers/首段文本 P95（2秒阈值）

panels.description: 首段可见文本成功样本内 2 秒占比；终态失败不填 0。

targets.expr: sum by (context_target, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_creator_polish_first_text" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_creator_polish_first_text" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_source_measurement_version="creator_polish_v1" | context_target=~"$polish_target" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | duration_ms <= 2000 [$__range])) / sum by (context_target, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_creator_polish_first_text" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_creator_polish_first_text" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_source_measurement_version="creator_polish_v1" | context_target=~"$polish_target" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" [$__range]))

panels.title: NDJSON 首段文本 2秒内占比

panels.description: complete/error/aborted/timeout 与 target/platform 分母；full duration 仅诊断，无 2 秒阈值。

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_target, event_data_tg_platform, event_data_outcome) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_creator_polish_terminal" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_creator_polish_terminal" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | event_data_source_measurement_version="creator_polish_v1" | event_data_target=~"$polish_target" | event_data_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" [$__auto]))

quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_creator_polish_full" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_creator_polish_full" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_source_measurement_version="creator_polish_v1" | context_target=~"$polish_target" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_target, context_tg_platform, context_outcome)

panels.title: NDJSON 完整流终态、N 与 full P95（无2秒 SLO）

panels.description: Fastify onResponse 的完整连接生命周期。SSE 与 NDJSON 一起用于容量/长尾诊断，不应用 2 秒阈值，也没有客户端平台标签。
panels.title: 服务端 SSE/NDJSON 完整流 P95（无2秒 SLO）

title: ST 流式接口响应与完整生命周期
